E_MAIN_MODEL.locator: Main Results, Cantilever-free probes as a distributed optical lever; Fig. 1
E_MAIN_MODEL.fact: The distributed optical lever model links backing deformation and reflection; the model estimate is about 1 nm, not demonstrated imaging precision.

E_FAB.locator: Main Methods, Fabrication of cantilever-free probe arrays; Fig. 1c-e
E_FAB.fact: Sapphire, compliant PDMS, directly written polymer probes and evaporated reflective aluminum form the array; cylinders are used for characterization.

E_ARRAY_CAL.locator: Main Results, Cantilever-free probes as a distributed optical lever; Fig. 2
E_ARRAY_CAL.fact: A 1088-probe array is mounted, leveled against flat silicon with force feedback, and optically calibrated from out-of-contact and contact states.

E_RELEASE.locator: Main Results, Topographical image reconstruction, first paragraph
E_RELEASE.fact: Vertical contact, stationary acquisition and withdrawal precede every lateral move; force-sensor evidence of release is required.

E_RECON.locator: Main Results, Topographical image reconstruction; Fig. 3; Methods, Image reconstruction
E_RECON.fact: Probe detection, per-probe intensity mapping, stitching, relative-height correction, frame offset removal and crosstalk correction form the analysis chain.

E_ARROW.locator: Main Results, Massively parallel imaging; Fig. 4a
E_ARROW.fact: An inert silicon calibration specimen has an arrow feature imaged at 1 micrometer lateral sampling; independent AFM depth is reported as 110 nm.

E_LINE.locator: Main Results, Massively parallel imaging; Fig. 4b
E_LINE.fact: A 100 nm lateral-step line measurement reports 126 nm mean step and 9 nm flat-region vertical precision over greater than 0.4 mm span.

E_COMPLEX.locator: Main Results, Massively parallel imaging; Fig. 4c
E_COMPLEX.fact: Another calibration-target region contains lines, pits and mesas; the reported acquisition is 256 seconds and processing 54 seconds.

E_SETUP.fact: TERA-Fab E-series, downward probes, piezo-controlled vertical/tilt and sample lateral stages, Grasshopper camera and 10x Mitutoyo NA 0.28 optics are the parallel-imaging setup.

E_SCAN.fact: Raster field is 15 by 15 micrometers with 1 micrometer steps and 15 micrometer hexagonal pitch; the separate high-resolution line step is 100 nm.

E_SI1.fact: Analytical contact/reflectance model and finite-bit-depth estimate; the small-displacement example is a calculation.

E_SI2.locator: SI Note 2 pp. 5-7, Supplementary Table 1 and Fig. 2
E_SI2.fact: COMSOL explores probe, backing and sample deformation over hypothetical sample moduli; only stiff silicon imaging is experimentally demonstrated.

E_SI3.fact: Cylinders on a compliant film are centered and indented by a calibrated conventional AFM; thermal PSD and rigid-glass optical sensitivity calibrate the lever.

E_SI4.fact: A seven-probe simulation gives a 0.29 neighboring displacement fraction; this differs from the empirical 0.35 image correction.

E_SI5.fact: Cylindrical-probe indentation is observed through sapphire with Nikon inverted brightfield, Grasshopper camera and 10x Olympus optics; the reported single-probe estimate is 6 nm.

E_SI6.fact: Four identified probes provide within-probe and between-probe repeatability analysis; these are not four independent specimen replications.

E_SI7.fact: Off-center normal indentation of a cylinder produces asymmetric optical deformation under torque; direct two-dimensional topographic-gradient mapping is prospective.

E_LIMITS.locator: Main Discussion and final Results paragraphs
E_LIMITS.fact: Large-array extension, MHz bandwidth, soft-sample capability and direct gradient mapping are prospective or calculated; flatness and vertical-range limitations remain.

E_DATA.locator: Main Data availability, Code availability, rights; SI p. 14 references
E_DATA.fact: Raw experiment data are available on request and external MATLAB code is linked; neither was inspected or executed in this conversion.

resolved_findings.detail: Retained array/lever custody is separate from exchanged targets/coupons. Final session teardown retrieves the probe and invalidates calibration.
Known/unknown contact at dock/mount and nonstationary mount endpoints now reject. Withdrawal is not treated as measured release.
SI page 8 typeset equation 15 really prints the denominator k_eff minus k_c. Its inconsistency with positive series stiffness is stated and quantitative analysis remains gated.
Episode identity is bound through context, jobs, observations and raw paths. Unknown context fields reject.
Qualification and version comparisons distinguish JSON boolean and numeric types.
Expected export paths are pinned independently; self-consistent publisher-file additions and symlink/path/hash/actor-scope mutations reject.

source_access_audit.si_visual_review: Upstream source auditor rendered and inspected all fourteen pages; conversion author read extracted text. This package does not claim fresh pixel QA.
source_access_audit.amendment_check: Upstream audit found no article-specific correction/retraction on 2026-10-04; absence is not proof.
source_access_audit.access_boundary: Existing retained legal source packet used; no access restriction bypass or new external request.
source_access_audit.si_conversion_author_pixel_check_purpose: Resolve Equation 15 sign ambiguity; the printed denominator is confirmed and preserved as a source conflict. No source pixel is exported.

conflicts.source_difference: Main opening Results reports about 0.5 mm and line Results greater than 0.4 mm; Discussion states 5 mm.
conflicts.required_handling: Do not infer a corrected historical span or use 5 mm as verified geometry. Qualified geometry remains mandatory.

conflicts.source_difference: About 1 nm model estimate, 6 nm single-probe optical estimate and 9 nm imaging precision are different quantities.
conflicts.required_handling: Keep separate outcome types and setups; none is a target supplied to the actor.

conflicts.source_difference: Empirical image correction is 35%; finite-element neighboring response is 29%.
conflicts.required_handling: Do not replace one with the other or label the simulation an observed correction.

conflicts.source_difference: Main parallel setup specifies 10x Mitutoyo NA 0.28; SI single-probe setup specifies 10x Olympus without NA.
conflicts.required_handling: Bind each calibration to its own optical configuration; changing optics invalidates reuse.

conflicts.source_difference: Main text discusses four-probe analysis after the intricate image; SI Note 6 explicitly uses the fiducial arrow dataset.
conflicts.required_handling: Preserve location discrepancy; the task uses the explicitly identified SI arrow dataset as a provenance-labeled analysis route, not a correction to main text.

conflicts.source_difference: Main normalized absolute brightness decreases with contact; SI baseline-subtracted filtered darkening metric increases.
conflicts.required_handling: Record metric definition and sign. Do not use one pipeline calibration for the other.

conflicts.source_difference: SI describes possible topography above 10 MPa; main distinguishes high-resolution topography near/above 1 GPa and nanomechanics between 10 MPa and 1 GPa.
conflicts.required_handling: Treat these as model-based regimes, not demonstrated soft-sample branches.

conflicts.source_difference: Pixel inspection of SI p. 8 confirms the printed equation k_cf = k_eff * k_c * (k_eff - k_c)^(-1). For positive-stiffness series springs with k_eff < k_c, that denominator yields a negative result, inconsistent with the reported positive stiffness values unless an unstated sign convention applies.
conflicts.required_handling: Preserve the printed denominator and report the source inconsistency. Do not silently repair the sign. Quantitative compliance analysis requires an explicitly reviewed equation/sign-convention disposition.
